support.contact.title: Contact and order support
support.contact.intro: Use this page as the central help surface for questions around ordering, checkout, delivery status, and storefront availability.
support.contact.sectionOneCopy: The webshop is designed to sit on top of ERP workflows. For account-specific questions, the fastest path is your operating company's existing procurement or service channel.
support.contact.sectionTwoCopy: If pricing, availability, shipping selection, or coupon handling looks incorrect, capture the affected product or order number and share it with your support contact to speed up diagnosis.
support.contact.sectionThreeCopy: The storefront keeps checkout lightweight, but order, shipping, and stock data still depend on connected backend services. During outages or maintenance windows, retry shortly or use your fallback support process.
support.shipping.title: Shipping information
support.shipping.intro: Shipping methods and delivery timelines are calculated from the active backend configuration and your destination country.
support.shipping.sectionOneCopy: Available products are presented with a dispatch-first buying flow. Actual shipment timing depends on warehouse stock, configured carriers, and order validation in the shop services.
support.shipping.sectionTwoCopy: Checkout lists the shipping methods currently available for the basket value and destination. Free shipping, delivery windows, and carrier descriptions are controlled by backend rules.
support.shipping.sectionThreeCopy: If a shipping method is missing or delivery estimates change unexpectedly, review the address details first. If the issue remains, contact support with the basket contents and destination country.
support.returns.title: Returns and refunds
support.returns.intro: Return handling should be predictable and easy to follow for buyers as well as operators.
support.returns.sectionOneCopy: Only products that meet the operating company's return conditions should be accepted. Keep product state, packaging, and order references available when starting a return request.
support.returns.sectionTwoCopy: Refund timing depends on the order workflow and accounting integration behind the webshop. Once a return is approved, reimbursement should follow the configured finance process.
support.returns.sectionThreeCopy: For damaged, incomplete, or incorrect shipments, collect the order number and affected items immediately. That gives support enough context to resolve replacements or corrections faster.
legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy overview
legal.privacy.intro: This webshop stores only the minimum data required to browse, build a cart, and complete an order flow.
legal.privacy.sectionOneCopy: The storefront uses a session identifier to persist the shopping cart between visits. That allows products, coupon state, and checkout progress to remain available while you continue shopping.
legal.privacy.sectionTwoCopy: Checkout collects shipping and contact details only to create the order and fulfill delivery. Those fields are transmitted to the backend services responsible for order management and logistics.
legal.privacy.sectionThreeCopy: Before publishing the webshop externally, replace this summary with the deploying organization's full privacy text, legal basis, retention periods, and contact details for data requests.
legal.terms.title: Terms and conditions overview
legal.terms.intro: These storefront terms describe the general buying flow, but the final commercial framework belongs to the operating organization.
legal.terms.sectionOneCopy: Products, prices, and stock states are rendered from backend services and may change until an order is successfully placed. The checkout confirms intent to purchase, not guaranteed fulfillment in all deployment scenarios.
legal.terms.sectionTwoCopy: Displayed prices, discounts, tax amounts, and shipping costs are calculated from the active service configuration. The final payable amount is shown in the order summary before submission.
legal.terms.sectionThreeCopy: A production launch should add operator-specific legal text covering payment terms, cancellation rights, liability, jurisdiction, and business-customer conditions where required.
legal.imprint.title: Imprint and operator notice
legal.imprint.intro: This ERP webshop is a deployable application surface. The legal operator information must be supplied by the organization that runs it.
legal.imprint.sectionOneCopy: The party responsible for this webshop is the company or organization that deploys the ERP system, connects the backend services, and publishes the storefront to buyers.
legal.imprint.sectionTwoCopy: Before public use, add the operator name, postal address, legal representatives, registration identifiers, and direct contact options required by the target jurisdiction.
legal.imprint.sectionThreeCopy: The storefront itself is part of the ERP System application stack. Technical behavior may depend on configured gateway, catalog, cart, order, and shipping services.
